title: CARE arXiv paper
summary: Public arXiv source for CARE, describing auditable control of LLM-generated policies in scientific experimentation.
content: arXiv:2606.14581. Title: CARE: Controlling LLM-Generated Policies through Auditable Review of Evidence in Scientific Experimentation.

title: CARE
summary: CARE keeps a non-LLM incumbent optimizer as the default action path and allows LLM-generated challenger policies only through a public-evidence intervention gate.
content: The paper evaluates CARE on Minerva/Olympus and ChemLex benchmarks. The key system idea is to separate creative proposal generation from auditable intervention approval.

title: High-throughput experiment optimization
summary: Sequentially choose experimental conditions from a finite candidate pool under a limited reveal budget.
content: The task setting covers reaction condition optimization with candidates such as ligand, catalyst, solvent, temperature, and substrate combinations. Objectives may include yield, selectivity, conversion, or cost-adjusted score.

title: Minerva/Olympus Suzuki coupling benchmark
summary: A Suzuki coupling finite-pool benchmark used in the CARE paper.
content: The CARE paper reports a 5,670-candidate replay setting with 30 matched seeds, 5 initial observations, and 10 reveal rounds. This public card records the benchmark interface; raw candidate tables are not included in this repository.

title: ChemLex acid-amine benchmark
summary: A reaction optimization benchmark used in the CARE paper.
content: The CARE paper reports a ChemLex replay setting for acid-amine combinations. This card tracks the dataset role in CARE experiments; raw candidate tables are not included in this repository.

title: Public-evidence intervention gate
summary: The gate compares incumbent and challenger proposals before outcome reveal and authorizes intervention only when pre-selection evidence supports the change.
content: A gate certificate should record the incumbent candidate, challenger candidate, evidence used, checks passed or failed, and the final accept/reject decision. The gate should not use hidden outcomes from the current reveal.

title: Audit log
summary: A replay trace that records each decision, gate certificate, reveal, and knowledge update.
content: The synthetic replay harness emits audit entries so each selected candidate can be inspected after the run. This is useful for debugging unsafe interventions and measuring rejected-good-challenger cases.

title: SkillCard
summary: A structured representation for reusable scientific decision heuristics.
content: In the replay smoke test, SkillCard objects define bounded policy adjustments such as ligand prior, ligand risk penalty, and diversity exploration. The goal is to keep skill effects inspectable and auditable.

title: Ligand prior skill
summary: A simple ranking prior that favors ligand identities associated with higher synthetic yields in the public/observed context.
content: The synthetic replay harness includes a ligand prior as a minimal example of a bounded, auditable policy skill. Real datasets should replace synthetic coefficients with evidence-derived rules.

title: Replace synthetic replay adapter
summary: Swap the synthetic Suzuki-like candidate pool with real Minerva/Olympus and ChemLex candidate tables when release-safe data is available.
content: The current experiment validates the CARE 2.0 software loop. The next step is to implement dataset adapters for real finite-pool replay and reproduce CARE paper baselines under matched seeds.
